page.layout: One page of text, with a Greek verb paradigm in parallel columns; small Latin labels in the left margin beside the paradigm (Poni, Positum esse, etc.); page number and running head at the top; catchword "VER" at the foot right.

main_text.head: Præteritum perfectum.
main_text.l: Si positus fuerim. τεθῶμαι | τεθῇς | τετῆνται.
main_text.head: Infinitum a.
main_text.l: Si positus fuero. ἐὰν τετῶ | τεθῆς | τεθῆ
main_text.head: INFINITIVUS.
main_text.l: Mox posi tum iri. Futurum a. τεθήσεσθαι.
main_text.head: PARTICIPIVM.
Præsens.
main_text.l: Qui ponitur. ὁ τιθέμενος, ἡ τιθεμένη, τὸ τιθέμενον.
main_text.head: Perfectum.
main_text.l: Hic positus. ὁ τεθειμένος, ἡ τεθειμένη, τὸ τεθειμένον.
main_text.head: Infinitum a.
main_text.l: Hic positus. ὁ τεθεὶς, ἡ τεθεῖσα, τὸ τεθέν.
main_text.head: Futurum a.
main_text.l: Hic ponendus. ὁ τεθησόμενος, ἡ τεθησομένη, τὸ τεθησόμενον.
main_text.head: Paulo post futurum.
main_text.l: Hic mox ponendus. ὁ τεθησόμενος, ἡ τεθησομένη, τὸ τεθησόμενον.

page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed as far as legible; accents and breathings in the small paradigm are approximate. Left-margin Latin labels are set beside the paradigm and are printed as marginal glosses. The left-margin labels are partly cut off at the gutter ("tum esse", "tum iri", "Mox posi").
